map.泪膜破裂时间 BUT/TBUT（秒）分级：不低于10 正常、5–10 泪膜不稳定: Tear film break-up time BUT/TBUT (seconds) grading: >=10 normal, 5-10 unstable tear film (mild-moderate dry eye), <5 clearly abnormal (moderate-severe dry eye); lower value means less stable film.
map.中国干眼共识：BUT<10s 为泪膜不稳定；<5s 提示泪膜严重不稳定。常联合: Chinese dry-eye consensus: BUT<10s is unstable tear film; <5s suggests severely unstable film. Often combined with Schirmer test and corneal fluorescein staining.
map.⚠️ BUT 受环境、眨眼及操作影响，建议取3次平均。结果仅供参考，干眼诊断需综: ⚠️ BUT is affected by environment, blinking and operation; take 3 averages. Results for reference only; dry-eye diagnosis needs symptoms and multiple exams.
map.依据泪膜破裂时间对泪膜稳定性进行分级，辅助干眼症筛查与随访。: Grades tear-film stability by break-up time, aiding dry-eye screening and follow-up.

map.荧光素后记录首次黑斑出现时间（秒），pct = 值/20×100。: After fluorescein, record first black-spot time (seconds), pct = value/20x100.
map.pct = 8/20×100 = 40%；属临界（5–10s），结合症状考虑蒸发: pct = 8/20x100 = 40%; borderline (5-10s), with symptoms consider evaporative dry eye.
map.显著缩短（<5s），泪膜极不稳定，典型干眼表现。: Markedly shortened (<5s), very unstable film, typical dry-eye presentation.
map.BUT 是客观指标、OSDI 是主观，二者结合诊断干眼。: BUT is objective, OSDI subjective; combining both diagnoses dry eye.
